name: Throw
_intent: Full-power overhand throw of a food item held in the right hand: turn side-on, lead knee up, long stride at the target, hips open before the shoulders, arm cocked and whipped over the top to a high release in front of the head, long follow-through across the body with the back leg swinging through, recover to a stand.
_reference: baseball pitch / javelin release phases (balance, stride, foot plant, max external rotation, release, deceleration, follow-through); release at frame 23

keyframes._note: SET: square stance, food held at the chest
pivot step: back foot off the floor
pivot step lands: back foot turned and behind, body half turned
BALANCE: side-on, lead knee up, weight back
STRIDE: lead leg reaches, throwing arm swings down and back, glove arm at target
FOOT PLANT: hips open, shoulders closed, arm cocked
LAYBACK: chest turning, forearm laid back behind the head
RELEASE: trunk over the lead leg, arm long and high
FOLLOW-THROUGH: arm across outside the lead knee, back leg swings
lead foot steps back under the hips
